project.name: enterprise-graphrag-context
project.description: Enterprise GraphRAG Context (EGC) - Bottom-Up Architecture (Fase 13 a 0)

decisions.D2: Regra de Ouro da Autoria Exclusiva (100% Marco Antonio Conceicao, coautoria de IA terminantemente proibida)
decisions.D3: Proibicao Absoluta de Travessoes Unicode (U+2013 / U+2014); utilizar unicamente hifens comuns (-)
decisions.D4: Regra C44: Decomposicao Modular Segura de Monolitos (Extracao cirurgica sem destruicao de codigo, proibicao absoluta de stubs como REMEDIATION_ID, raiz de composicao funcional e testes unitarios 100% verdes com rollback imediato)
decisions.D33: Protecao Absoluta de Arquivos de Configuracao e Assinatura Signed-off-by Obrigatoria

tdd-guide.protocol: Must generate isolated, reproducing unit test before proposing fixes. Test file must be included in the commit.

build-error-resolver.protocol: When encountering monolith files (>800 LOC), must decompose responsibilities into clean modular files (routes, controllers, services). Absolute prohibition of erasing code, emptying files, or replacing logic with empty stubs/placeholders like 'export const REMEDIATION_ID'. Original file must remain as a functional composition root importing submodules with 100% functional preservation. Unit tests must be executed with 100% PASS, reverting immediately upon any failure or regression.

c44-safe-refactor-agent.role: Architectural Monolith Decomposer & Safe Refactoring Specialist
c44-safe-refactor-agent.protocol: Decomposes monolithic files into cleanly structured submodules without deleting functional logic. Re-exports or integrates submodules from the main file. Never generates REMEDIATION_ID stubs. Executes unit tests covering extracted routines and executes immediate rollback if any test fails.

governance-guard.protocol: Blocks any PR or commit that modifies protected configuration files without explicit integrity verification, or attempts to wipe code/insert REMEDIATION_ID stubs under C44.
